body.name: Recursive comparison and explicit moving-boundary handle
body.construction: Apply parameter-independent recursive binomial-to-normal Markov kernels on fixed positive-support strata. For the declared finite active list \(\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\), retain exactly \(\zeta_{n,j}(u)=c_{n,j}+a_j^{\prime}u+e_{n,j}(u)\), require limiting offsets to lie in \(\mathcal K_0\), deactivate a facet only when its displayed slack diverges to its feasible side, and charge localization at tolerance \(\tau\) by \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\). Localize the common transferred rule before compact exhaustion and add covariance, tail, comparison, and semantic-union diameter charges to the outward ledger.
inputs: a certified Gaussian rule for the relevant offset experiment
the explicitly declared local multinomial family \(p_n(u)\)
